text:
maya: uploaded nova35b-converted safetensors to gs://redwood-models/nova35b/v1/ — shards split into 8 TP shards, files are: model-00001-of-00008.safetensors ...00008.safetensors and an index.json.
cheng: awesome, thanks. can you confirm the shardmap layout? is it interleaved TP or contiguous slices? we need to know for runtime KV ordering. :eyes:
maya: it was produced by the conversion script with --tp 8, so I believe it produced contiguous ranges (0..N/8). not interleaved. conversion log attached inline:
```
python convert.py --src weights.pt --out safetensors --tp 8 --dtype fp16 --write-index
# wrote shards 0..7 as contiguous slices
```
liam: quick ping — which dtype was actually written? fp16 or bf16? some downstream tests fail if mismatch.
maya: fp16 for weights, embeds were left as bf16 in some layers — the converter mixed types to save mem. I can re-run fully fp16 if we prefer.
sofia: tokenizer check: tokenizer.json in the bucket is missing "bos_token" field for this model, conv tests flagged it. Might be fine for most, but please add explicit bos/eos to avoid chat bugs.
cheng: ok two things to validate before we mark onboarding ready:
1) shardmap index ordering matches runtime expectation (we expect contiguous sharding).
2) all shards pass SHA256 integrity and safetensors header has correct metadata: "dtype" and "tp_rank".
liam: I ran a quick check locally:
```
# verify index references match physical files
python -c "import json,os; idx=json.load(open('index.json')); print([f for f in idx['files']])"
sha256sum model-000* | awk '{print $1}' > checksums.txt
```
deploy-bot: INTEGRITY_CHECK: model-00005-of-00008.safetensors failed checksum validation on host-build-12 :warning: (expected 3a7f..., got 0000...)
maya: ugh, thanks deploy-bot — that's probably a partial upload. I'll reupload shard 5 and re-run index write. will push within 10m.
sofia: after reupload, can someone run the tokenizer roundtrip test? small script:
```
# tokenization roundtrip
from tokenizers import Tokenizer
t = Tokenizer.from_file('tokenizer.json')
assert t.encode('Hello').tokens[0] is not None
```
cheng: I also added a tiny index validator to our repo, run with:
```
./tools/validate_safetensors_index --index index.json --shard-dir . --expected-tp 8 --expected-dtype fp16
```
liam: FYI if we decide to keep mixed dtype we need to record that in model card and console metadata or serving will quantize unexpectedly.
maya: re-uploaded shard 5, re-generated index.json with --write-index-v2 (now includes per-file sha256 and tp_rank).
deploy-bot: INTEGRITY_CHECK: re-scan passed for all shards :white_check_mark:
sofia: tokenizer passed basic roundtrip. added missing bos_token to tokenizer.json and pushed to the same bucket.
cheng: great. last ask: can you include a small README in the model folder describing sharding convention and the converter flags used (tp layout, dtype, any layer exceptions). runtime team will use that.
maya: adding README.md now. will also include the exact convert command and git commit hash.
liam: LGTM. tagging this for serve-readiness checklist. once README + index v2 + tokenizer updated, we can schedule a canary deploy.
maya: thanks all — marking this thread resolved for now. :thumbsup:
